description: RETIRED: Polygon Safe wallets are retired and Felix answers 410 polygon_safe_hub_retired; every account's wallet is its Arc home Safe (fund it with create_deposit; stop all trading with panic). Start advanced client-owned Safe onboarding. The owner key must be generated and retained outside Felix; only public addresses are sent. Read felix://getting-started before implementing the signing flow.

daily_limit_usd.description: Maximum autonomous daily total. Defaults to 500.

delegation_days.description: Owner-signed agent delegation lifetime. Defaults to 30 days; maximum 90.

home_address.description: Optional fixed sweep-home address. Defaults to owner.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry-safety key. Auto-generated when omitted.

lifetime_limit_usd.description: Maximum cumulative autonomous total for this module. Defaults to daily limit multiplied by delegation days.

max_operation_usd.description: Maximum autonomous operation size. Defaults to 100.

name: init_wallet_onboarding
